summary: One annual challenge with no list of calls and no published deadline. The page says the next round opens 1 Jan 2027. The only feed on the host is a news feed, so it is rejected. Monitor the application page with the html adapter.
attempted: endpoint_recon.py on the your-application URL: verdict rss, but the feed is the general news feed (rss-whh.xml, 30 items, all press releases). Rejected.
adapter_check rss on rss-whh.xml: ok count=29, all news and press releases with deadline null. False positive, rejected.
Probed /feed, /rss, /wp-json/wp/v2/types, /wp-json/wp/v2/posts on www.welthungerhilfe.org: 404 (TYPO3, no WP API).
Sitemap: welthungerhilfe.org/sitemap.xml is an index to /s/pages/sitemap.xml (CMS page sitemap, no funding items). robots.txt points to .de sitemaps; news.xml 404.

Parsed page HTML: no __NEXT_DATA__, no embedded opportunity JSON, no XHR calls beyond cookie/consent and icon assets. ld+json is a BreadcrumbList only. Chrome found 16 XHR, none carrying opportunity data.
Checked external links: no portal (Submittable, SmartSimple, Fluxx, Typeform, Airtable) linked from the page. The apply flow is referenced on seedingthefuture.org.

seedingthefuture.org (partner foundation): /challenge page says 'Applications open Jan 1, 2027' and 'Hosted by our partner, Welthungerhilfe'. Its /feed, /rss, /wp-json return 404. Its sitemap.xml is a 200 with about 40 CMS pages, no opportunity records.
adapter_check html on the your-application URL: ok=true, text_len=16930, http=200, count=0 (html monitor stores no rows, as expected).

check.rss_rejected_candidate: {"ok":true,"count":29,"sample":[{"external_id":"article-6355","title":"Statement by Mathias Mogge, Welthungerhilfe CEO, on the floods in Gaza","deadline":null,"status":"open"}],"error":null,"http":200}

notes: The html adapter's labeled-future-date rule may read 'Applications open Jan 1, 2027' as next_deadline. That is an open date, not a close date. Treat next_deadline from this source with care, or review it when the round opens.
Do not use the rss-whh.xml feed: it is general news, and the rss adapter would store news as funding rows.
